about: What port/tools/hostgen/release_rac1.py needs of this release besides the decompilation: its ids, and the facts each one is read from.
title: Ratchet & Clank (NTSC-J)
label: NTSC-J v1.02

omit.func_00201AF0: draw_bootImage: NTSC-J's catalogue (config/versions/jp/functions.tsv) has no counterpart of it, so the shared C's wrapper of it is left out.
omit.func_001F75D0: FontPrintWindow in the small font: NTSC-J has no counterpart of it (its catalogue's func_J_001F8688 is a second copy of the large font's), so the shared C's replacement is left out.
omit.func_001E9E70: The level sky routine (sky.c): not carried to this disc yet (its frame draw's level copies are not checked here).
omit.func_L02_0023D6E0: Aridia's counters with "HUD: Edges" (hud.c): NTSC-J's anchors are not paired yet, so that part is left out.

RAC1_FONT_PRINT_WINDOW: FontPrintWindow as NTSC-J's own C calls it: its font_print_window_regular (src/versions/jp/game/render/draw/func_001F7560.c) draws with func_J_001F81F8, its own routine, not PAL v2.00's func_001F7070.
